name: Mana From Within
description:
You accumulate MP in the form of a mana pool: a store of magical-emotional energy.

Mana added to your mana pool remains there until an ability removes it, you release it as a free action, or you roll initiative.

When you use mana to pay an ability's mana cost, that mana remains in your mana pool, but becomes tapped: you may not use it again until it is untapped. All mana in your mana pool is automatically untapped at the start of each of your turns.

Whenever you roll 💀 on a skill check for an ability with a mana cost, remove the mana cost of that ability from your mana pool and check a Condition. Then the GM takes a Soft Move as normal.

Abilities that grant or take away MP affect your Mana Pool, adding or removing mana, 1-for-1. You choose which color of mana is added or removed.

Describe how you channel your emotions into magic.
